title: Product-design skill registry index
description: Canonical machine-readable index of every skill in this repository. CATALOG.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and .claude-plugin/* are generated from this file by scripts/catalog-build.mjs; scripts/search.mjs reads only this file. Conditional rules that JSON Schema alone cannot express cleanly (e.g. provenance fields required only for third-party sources) are enforced by scripts/validate.mjs and documented on each field.

version.description: Index format version. Bump only on breaking schema changes.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Must equal the skill's leaf directory name.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the skill makes the agent do.

category.description: Must equal the skill's parent directory name under skills/. Defined in catalog/taxonomy.md.

tags.description: Controlled vocabulary; every tag must appear in the tag block of catalog/taxonomy.md.

triggers.description: Example phrases or situations that should activate this skill.

inputs.description: What the skill expects to work on (e.g. source code, URL, screenshot, research notes).

outputs.description: What the skill produces (e.g. findings, severity ratings, artifact).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the skill directory (containing SKILL.md).

compatibility.description: Agent environments the skill is expected to work in. Listed only when the format was checked against that environment's documented conventions; claude-ai is excluded when frontmatter uses non-spec fields.

dependencies.description: Runtime/tool dependencies beyond a plain agent (e.g. node, python, playwright, browser). Empty for prose-only skills.

relatedSkills.description: IDs of related skills in this index. Every entry must resolve; no self-reference.

recommended.description: True when this is the default choice within its overlap group (see catalog/duplicates-and-overlaps.md).

maturity.description: stable = proven upstream or well-tested; experimental = new or lightly used.

status.description: verified = every file inspected during a research run, license confirmed redistributable at the pinned commit, provenance complete, zero validation errors. draft = vendored/authored but not yet fully audited. deprecated = superseded; excluded from search unless --all.

type.description: third-party = vendored from an upstream repository; original = authored in this repository.

repository.description: Upstream repository as owner/repo. Required (non-null) for third-party; null for original.

url.description: URL of the upstream skill (tree URL at the vendored path). Required for third-party.

author.description: Upstream author or organization. Required for third-party.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the license governing the skill's content (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0). For original skills: MIT (this repository's license).

licenseFile.description: Filename of the upstream license text vendored inside the skill directory (usually LICENSE.txt). Required for third-party; null for original.

upstreamPath.description: Path of the skill directory inside the upstream repository at the pinned commit. Required for third-party.

upstreamCommit.description: 40-hex commit SHA the files were vendored from. Required for third-party.

retrievedAt.description: ISO date the files were retrieved and inspected. Required for third-party.

modified.description: True iff the local copy differs from upstream. Must equal modifications.length > 0.

reason.description: Third-party skills are modified only for these reasons, never for style.
